name: @local/theme-switcher
description: Local Quartz component plugin scaffold for a toolbar theme switcher

scripts.test: npm run build && node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const { readdirSync } = require('node:fs'); const filter = process.argv[1] ?? ''; const files = readdirSync('test').filter((name) => name.endsWith('.test.ts') && (!filter || name.includes(filter))).map((name) => 'test/' + name); if (files.length === 0) { console.error('No test files matched ' + filter); process.exit(1); } const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['--test', ...files], { stdio: 'inherit' }); process.exit(result.status ?? 1);"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build

quartz.name: theme-switcher
quartz.description: Toolbar component for selecting local visual theme presets.
